jobs.description:
BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. As the technical owner of the electrical design, you bridge project requirements and practical implementation, making sure every machine is engineered to the highest quality and safety standards.
 

Electrical design and project planning
 
 

• From the conceptual phase onwards, you take part in project design meetings with multidisciplinary engineering teams 

• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the joint planning meetings 

• After the concept phase, you take ownership of the electrical descriptions and translate draft descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design 

• You design and adjust the electrical drawings in Eplan P8 and the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Pro Panel 

• You make sure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN 60204, MD, EMC, LVD and others)  

Execution and collaboration
 
 

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines 

• You follow up closely with production during assembly 

• As a senior, you develop, maintain and improve electrical design guidelines and best practices 

• You support colleagues and review schematics with them for accuracy 

• You contribute to standardisation initiatives in the department and gradually take the lead in driving them forward  

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 
 

• A master's degree in industrial sciences (electromechanics or electrotechnics), or equivalent experience 

• At least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in machine building 

• Solid knowledge of electrical standards; knowledge of UL standards is a plus 

• Good knowledge of Eplan P8; Eplan Pro Panel is a plus 

• An analytical mind and a problem solver 

• A good communicator and team player in an international environment 

• Good knowledge of English and Dutch

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.
This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.
Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 
Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do

• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to KnowYou’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:

• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Purpose and Mission
 

To ensure Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert are the solution of choice in offshore operations applications (Single Point Mooring & Lifting Solutions). Organize and manage all commercial activity related to offshore operations. Create opportunities and secure orders to ensure the business meets its commercial objectives in line with the profit plan and agreed objectives and strategies.
This opportunity is ideally suited for a 
junior professional with a strong commercial drive and the ambition to grow in an international environment. The position involves 
approximately 40% international travel to build and strengthen customer relationships and explore new business opportunities.
 

Key Activities and Responsibilities
 

1. Identify concrete market potential, emerging trends, and industry shifts, including targeted qualification of key (lead) accounts within defined Single Point Mooring (SPM) applications. 
2. Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships between the organization and (potential) customers. 
3. Maintain and build worldwide strong network with agents. 
4. Negotiate effectively within commercial proposals to finalize sales agreements, ensuring acceptable deliverables and realistic timelines while balancing strict customer requirements with mutual commercial interests. 
5. Increase annual revenue from existing accounts by offering new products and services, identifying market opportunities and developing these into commercial solutions, and continuously evaluating the existing product range in line with 
6. Contribute to gathering relevant market intelligence by analyzing competitor products and customer feedback, and proactively adjusting commercial approaches accordingly. 
7. Collaborate closely with internal departments/teams to ensure the highest product quality and performance in order to fully meet customer expectations. 
8. Initiate and personally follow up on new R&D projects based on market perspectives and customer requirements. 
9. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
10. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
11. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
12. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
13. Ensure accurate (pre-)sales administration, including quotation management, technical support coordination, contract compliance, sales order booking, lead-time and deliverable tracking, communication with support departments, customer payment follow-up, and non-conformity processes. 
14. Maintain up-to-date theoretical and practical technical knowledge relevant to the segment. 
15. Achieve segment sales results by meeting budgeted revenue and sales targets. 
16. Position Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert at the center of the offshore lifting ecosystem, building positive relationships with lifting engineers, rigging specialists, operators, and other stakeholders to ensure our products are widely accepted and specified in tenders. 
17. Responsible for visual inspection of slings, ensuring accurate assessment, proper documentation, and compliance with regulatory requirements. 
18. Attend proof load tests, ensuring all procedures were performed to the required standards and verifying that goods met criteria for successful delivery.

• Strong commercial acumen with a track record of positive results in previous sales, business development, or project 
management roles. 
• Experience in offshore lifting, mooring, heavy lifting, or similar industries is a strong advantage. 
• Ability to develop and manage multiple accounts, balancing long-term relationship building with short-term revenue generation. 
• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders. 
• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix management organization and collaborate across internal teams to deliver high-quality solutions. 
• Ability to analyze key sales data and translate findings into actionable business strategies. 
• Self-starter, able to work independently with minimal supervision, while also being a team player.
